title: At a rational closed point of a locally finite type scheme over a field, stalk dimension equals topological local dimension.
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_rationalPoint_eq_topologicalKrullDimAt
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hp : p ≫ f = 𝟙 _) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))) =
      topologicalKrullDimAt (p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))

proof.text: Use a closed immersion section over Spec k to see the rational point is closed. Choose an affine open immersion containing it and the corresponding maximal prime. The chart structure ring is finite type over k by locally finite type of the composite. Apply the affine closed-point localization dimension comparison. Transport ring dimension via the open-immersion stalk isomorphism and Spec.stalkIso; transport local topological dimension via cofinal open neighbourhoods. For the open-immersion topological comparison, use preimages and open images of neighbourhoods, comparing their dimensions by the existing inducing-map inequality and embedding range equality; no homeomorphism-local-dimension helper is restated.
